title: TrackScout answers document
description: Served at GET /data/owner_answers.json: the latest answer per question, keyed by question id. The server returns 404 while there are no answers at all, so an empty object is valid here. POSTed through POST /api/answer; re-POSTing a known id replaces the stored answer (the server also keeps an append-only answers.jsonl history).

champ1a.answer: Three arches and a central balcony

id.description: The question id being answered; should match the object key.

answer.description: The owner's answer. For yesno/choice it is the label of the chosen option; every type also accepts the protocol values `Don't know` (owner unsure - the decision stays open) and `WRONG LOCATION` (the pavement point is wrong; the correction is carried in `comment`).

comment.description: Optional free text. For `WRONG LOCATION` the app puts the corrected `lat, lon` in here.

time.description: Server stamp of the latest POST, local time, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.
